name: Beck Suicide Intent Scale (SIS)
directions: Clinician interview about the patient’s most recent suicide attempt, covering objective circumstances and the patient’s perceptions. Items 1–15 contribute to the total. Code not applicable responses as −8 and exclude them from the total. Items 16–20 are additional aspects and are not included in the total.
interpretationNote: The supplied text says the total is the sum of items 1–15, excluding items coded −8. The application records responses but does not calculate a total because the −8 missing/not-applicable handling is not supported by the generic scorer. Use only as a clinician interview aid, not as a stand-alone risk determination.
